title: Inventory exact Phase 9 G03 claims and V4 implementation destinations
goal: Prevent a governance.json-only migration from silently omitting active G03 specialized-gate obligations.
acceptanceCriteria: The current V3 Post entry point, Phase 9 execution path, every aggregate check and every catalog error code are enumerated with source hash and V4 destination.
The inventory distinguishes catalog/governance facts, source and snapshot reconciliation, documentation, and closeout readiness, including fresh and zero-subject evidence needs.
Formal Pre/Diff, source hash checks, isolated IFX package regression and published Package identity pass without accepting a C2 module or production Profile.
